title: Dual-axis spurious trend correlation trap
what: Raw r = 0.99 is driven by shared time drift; detrended correlation collapses to r = 0.05 (YoY diff r = -0.06)

reader_questions.question: What is the correlation after removing the shared time trend?
reader_questions.expected: Near zero (detrended r = 0.05, YoY difference r = -0.06).

reader_questions.question: Why was the raw correlation so high?
reader_questions.expected: Both series grew steadily over 2012–2025, inflating raw r to 0.99 without any real link.

reader_questions.question: Should a dual y-axis chart be used to claim coupling?
reader_questions.expected: No; overlapping dual axes visually manufacture a spurious link between independent upward trends.
